summary: Move repository configuration from .st to .fractal, updating the ci-script-tests and genie-freshness lane definition directories and configuration ci_inputs to .fractal. The ci-script-tests tree_inputs retain the .st/.fractal bridge pair. Readers continue to prefer .fractal and use .st only when the preferred file is absent at the same pinned revision or checkout root.

replay.detail: No graph, replay or runtime state-directory change. Tracked repository configuration moves, with two lane definition-directory entries updated to the new location.

schema.detail: Configuration schemas are unchanged. The ci-script-tests and genie-freshness definition_paths directory entries change from .st to .fractal; ci-script-tests tree_inputs retain both .st and .fractal. Configuration ci_inputs change to .fractal: plain evidence-skip-policy.json inputs for linux-clippy and linux-fleet-compat; evidence-skip-policy.json check selectors for fractal-web, linux-gate, rust-tests and typescript-client; and required-lanes.json lane selectors for those four lanes plus linux-clippy and linux-fleet-compat. Both selector spellings resolve identically; .fractal is used consistently.

compatibility.detail: The existing absence-only .st fallback remains; malformed or unreadable .fractal configuration does not fall back. Pinned readers select configuration from that same revision, never another revision. No CLI, API or wire change.

downtime.detail: No service restart or host mutation is required.

manual.detail: Readiness requires verification of all production configuration readers and accepted bases. The change lands alone in a planned merge window. PRs branched before this change must merge main before signing. Nathan reviews after merge; no pre-merge Nathan Factory sign-off is required, per the Johannes no-wait decision in compoundingtech/fractal#4898. Retain the absence-only legacy fallback until consumer adoption is evidenced by the required peer receipts and the owner approves its removal.

recovery.detail: Revert the config-file move; retained readers still accept the legacy layout.
